question: Should OpenClaw add a native parent-scoped mid-run send API for sub-agents, and if so should it be a dedicated `sessions_send_parent` tool or a reserved `sessionKey: "parent"` selector?
rationale: This is a model-facing child-to-parent authorization edge; automation can confirm the missing behavior but cannot choose the permanent security and product contract.

options.title: Add dedicated parent-only send
options.body: Introduce `sessions_send_parent` or an equivalent trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from spawn/session metadata and rejects missing, stale, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, and chained forwarding targets.

options.title: Reserve `sessionKey: "parent"`
options.body: Keep the existing `sessions_send` tool name but make `parent` a special resolver value with the same strict direct-parent checks and tests.

options.title: Decline native mid-run sends
options.body: Keep completion handoff and `sessions_yield` as the supported orchestration path, and document broader opt-in tools as advanced operator-owned workarounds.

recommendation.title: Add dedicated parent-only send
recommendation.body: Introduce `sessions_send_parent` or an equivalent trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from spawn/session metadata and rejects missing, stale, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, and chained forwarding targets.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent code and issue-review history ties this maintainer to the relevant session tools, visibility, docs, and security boundary decisions.
